artefact.producer: the narrow SARIF adapter before the identity model was extracted

documentDifferences.why: the adapter's own digest changed because its source changed; no fingerprint is computed over it

method: the identity model was substituted for the adapter's private fingerprint functions, the A1 sources were re-projected in memory, and every result's three fingerprints were compared with the recorded values at the same position; the recorded artefact was read only
notes: the committed evidence/a1/SARIF.json was not rewritten; the recorded fingerprints remain the recorded values
the adapter digest recorded in the artefact names the pre-extraction producer, which is a fact about the artefact, not a fingerprint
a mismatch in any fingerprint would be recorded here as a migration with the old value retained, not silently replaced
